info.title: HomeHub
info.description: Self-hosted family wall-calendar and chores. /api/v1 routes need a bearer token unless the server runs with HOMEHUB_TRUST_NETWORK=1.

get.description: Server-to-server read of PantryPal `GET /api/v1/plans/current`, normalized to days × meals. Cached for 5 minutes; the last good response is served (stale: true) when PantryPal is unreachable. Recipe URLs deep-link into the PantryPal web app. 404 when the module is disabled; 503 when PantryPal is not configured or unreachable.

503.description: PantryPal not configured or unreachable and no cached response

get.summary: Meals planned in a date range
get.description: Reads the PantryPal plans overlapping `[start, end)` (a rolling week can straddle two plan weeks) and returns their days merged and date-ordered, normalized like `/meals/current`. Cached for 5 minutes per range; the last good response is served (stale: true) when PantryPal is unreachable. Days without a plan are omitted, so an absent day is an empty day, not an error. 404 when the module is disabled; 503 when PantryPal is not configured or unreachable.

get.summary: Meal boards for a date range, enriched with recipe details
get.description: Like `/meals/plan` but each meal also carries the recipe photo, total time, cuisine and left-over provenance. Recipe details come from PantryPal `GET /api/v1/recipes/{id}` (deduplicated per request, cached for an hour); a missing recipe leaves the extra fields null rather than failing the board. 404 when the module is disabled; 503 when PantryPal is not configured or unreachable.

get.summary: Shopping list, pantry gaps and expiring food
get.description: Read-only kitchen snapshot: the newest open PantryPal shopping list grouped by aisle, ingredients the current plan needs but the pantry cannot cover, and pantry rows expiring within five days. Each section is fetched independently; a failing section degrades to empty instead of failing the response. Cached for 5 minutes, last good response served as stale. 404 when the module is disabled; 503 when PantryPal is not configured or unreachable.

503.description: PantryPal not configured or unreachable and no cached response
